newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot knows no reason for shr price drop.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot knows no reason for shr price drop.

text.p: Home Depot Inc said on Thursday that it is expecting "1996 to be another great year" and that a drop in its stock price appears to have no relationship to its current or future financial performance.
The company said it is comfortable with analysts' estimates for the third quarter and the year, which it said indicate another year of record sales and profits.
Home Depot shares were down 3/4 to 54-1/4 in late trading on Thursday.
The company's fiscal 1996 year ends February 2, 1997, said company spokeswoman Kim Shreckengost.
According to First Call, analysts' consensus estimates for Home Depot earnings are $0.46 for the fiscal third quarter and $1.92 for the year.
"We're comfortable with estimates, and those are estimates as according to First Call," Shreckengost said.
